23363-a-midnight-fantasy.title: A Midnight Fantasy
23363-a-midnight-fantasy.creator: Thomas Bailey Aldrich
23363-a-midnight-fantasy.description: A book by Thomas Bailey Aldrich. The white granite façade over yonder--the Somerset Club--might well have been the house of Capulet: there was the clambering vine reaching up like a pliant silken ladder; there, near by, was the low-hung balcony, wanting only the slight girlish figure--immortal shape of fire and dew!--to make the illusion perfect.

arxiv-2109-06944.title: Minimum Path Star Topology Algorithms for Weighted Regions and Obstacles
arxiv-2109-06944.creator: King, Tyler, Soltys, Michael
arxiv-2109-06944.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Shortest path algorithms have played a key role in the past century, paving the way for modern day GPS systems to find optimal routes along static systems in fractions of a second. One application of these algorithms includes optimizing the total distance of power lines (specifically in star topological configurations).

arxiv-2307-07051.title: Making the Most Out of the Limited Context Length: Predictive Power Varies with Clinical Note Type and Note Section
arxiv-2307-07051.creator: Hongyi Zheng, Yixin Tracy Zhu, Lavender Yao Jiang, Kyunghyun Cho, Eric Karl Oermann, NYU Center for Data Science, NYU Langone Health {hz2212, yz5880, lyj2002, kyunghyun.cho}@nyu.edu, eric.oermann@nyulangone.org
arxiv-2307-07051.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models have led to renewed interest in natural language processing in healthcare using the free text of clinical notes. One distinguishing characteristic of clinical notes is their long time span over multiple long documents.

arxiv-2402-09110.title: Theory of biexciton-polaritons in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers
arxiv-2402-09110.creator: Andrey Kudlis, Ivan A. Aleksandrov, Mikhail M. Glazov, Ivan A. Shelykh
arxiv-2402-09110.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate a nonlinear optical response of a planar microcavity with an embedded transition metal dicalcogenide monolayer when the energy of a biexcitonic transition is brought in resonance with the energy of a cavity mode. We demonstrate that the emission spectrum of this system strongly depends on an external pump.

arxiv-2406-04096.title: Multiplicity dependence of (multi)strange hadrons in oxygen-oxygen collisions at s NN = 7 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}~=~7 TeV using EPOS4 and AMPT
arxiv-2406-04096.creator: M. U. Ashraf, A. M. Khan, J. Singh, G. Nigmatkulov, H. Roch, S. Kabana
arxiv-2406-04096.description: Abstract It is anticipated that the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) will collect data from oxygen-oxygen ( O + O \rm O+O ) collisions at a center-of-mass energy of s NN = 7 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}~=~7 TeV to explore the effects observed in high multiplicity proton-proton ( p + p \rm p+p ) and proton-lead ( p + Pb \rm p+Pb ) collisions

arxiv-2410-18632.creator: Pintu Debnath, Sayan Goswami
arxiv-2410-18632.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pintu Debnath, Sayan Goswami. Using the methods from topological dynamics, H. Furstenberg introduced the notion of a central set and proved the famous Central Sets Theorem. De, Neil Hindman, and D. Math.199 (2008), 155-175.] established a stronger version of the Central Sets Theorem and then introduced the notion of C C -sets satisfying the Central Sets Theorem and studied the properties of these sets.

arxiv-2504-14623.title: Synthesising Asynchronous Automata from Fair Specifications
arxiv-2504-14623.creator: Béatrice Bérard, Benjamin Monmege, B Srivathsan, Arnab Sur
arxiv-2504-14623.description: Abstract Asynchronous automata are a model of distributed finite state processes synchronising on shared actions. A celebrated result by Zielonka shows how a deterministic asynchronous automaton (AA) can be synthesised, starting from two inputs: a global specification given as a deterministic finite-state automaton (DFA) and a distribution of the alphabet into local alphabets for each process.

pmc-10598971.creator: Naif H. Ali, Hayder M. Al-kuraishy, Ali I. Al-Gareeb, Saud A. Alnaaim, Athanasios Alexiou, Marios Papadakis, Hebatallah M. Saad, Gaber El-Saber Batiha
pmc-10598971.description: Autophagy is an explicit cellular process to deliver dissimilar cytoplasmic misfolded proteins, lipids and damaged organelles to the lysosomes for degradation and elimination. The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) is the main negative regulator of autophagy. The mTOR pathway is involved in regulating neurogenesis, synaptic plasticity, neuronal development and excitability.

pmc-11402945.title: Trusted artificial intelligence for environmental assessments: An explainable high-precision model with multi-source big data
pmc-11402945.creator: Haoli Xu, Xing Yang, Yihua Hu, Daqing Wang, Zhenyu Liang, Hua Mu, Yangyang Wang, Liang Shi, Haoqi Gao, Daoqing Song, Zijian Cheng, Zhao Lu, Xiaoning Zhao, Jun Lu, Bingwen Wang, Zhiyang Hu
pmc-11402945.description: Environmental assessments are critical for ensuring the sustainable development of human civilization. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in these assessments has shown great promise, yet the "black box" nature of AI models often undermines trust due to the lack of transparency in their decision-making processes, even when these models demonstrate high accuracy.

pmc-11419817.title: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing reveals cell types, genes, and regulatory factors influencing melanogenesis in the breast muscle of Xuefeng black-bone chicken
pmc-11419817.creator: Peng Li, Xu Wei, Qiongtao Zi, Xiangyong Qu, Changqing He, Bing Xiao, Songchang Guo
pmc-11419817.description: The black-bone chicken, known for its high melanin content, holds significant economic value due to this unique trait. Particularly notable is the prominent melanin deposition observed in its breast muscle. However, the molecular mechanisms governing melanin synthesis and deposition in the breast muscle of black-bone chickens remain largely unknown.

pmc-11440693.title: Topic identification and content analysis of internet medical policies under the background of Healthy China 2030
pmc-11440693.creator: Guoping Wu, Hao Ning, Youshu Yuan, Junbai Chen, Guoxiang Li, Shuang Liu, Zhiwei Wang
pmc-11440693.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to analyse the content of internet medical policies, grasp the inherent laws of the development of internet medical policies and provide references for improving the policy system.MethodsOn the basis of web crawler technology, 436 internet medical policies issued by the central and local governments after the Healthy China Strategy was proposed were collected.

pmc-11459480.title: Structural and Functional Alterations of the Deltoid Muscle After Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair: A 2-Year Longitudinal Observation Study
pmc-11459480.creator: Tetsuya Seto, Kiminori Yukata, Kenzo Fujii, Kazuya Uehara, Hiroki Yamagata, Atsushi Mihara, Ryuta Iwanaga, Masahiro Funaba, Yasuaki Imajo, Hiroshi Fujii, Kazuteru Doi, Takashi Sakai
pmc-11459480.description: Background:Deltoid muscle detachment and atrophy have been reported to occur after shoulder surgery.Purpose:To investigate the 2-year changes in deltoid muscle structure and function after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair (ARCR) using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and electrophysical examination.Study Design:Case series; Level of evidence, 4.Methods:A total of 72 patients (72 shoulders) who underwent ARCR between 2015 and 2020 were enrolled.

pmc-11470917.title: Electromechanical coupling modeling and fractional-order control of the seeker stabilization platform
pmc-11470917.creator: Yanyu Song, Qingdang Li, Mingyue Zhang
pmc-11470917.description: To address the electromechanical coupling and multi-source disturbance problems of the seeker stabilized platform, this paper constructs an electromechanical coupling model of the seeker stabilized platform based on the Lagrange-Maxwell equation. To mitigate the influence of electromechanical coupling on the control performance of the seeker, a super-twisting controller based on a fractional-order terminal sliding mode surface (FOSTSMC) is proposed.

pmc-11478430.title: Study on the Effect of Electron/Hole Injection on the Energy-Storage Properties of Polymer Dielectrics
pmc-11478430.creator: Guang Liu, Yuhao Chen, Yang Cui, Lifang Shen, Taiquan Wu, Chen Chen, Yunxia Luo, Shubin Yan
pmc-11478430.description: As a critical component of electrostatic capacitors, the polymer dielectric directly affects the performance of the capacitor. In this work, Polycarbonate (PC)/Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) asymmetric bilayer polymer dielectrics were prepared, and the influence of different polymer materials’ barrier characteristics on various electrical properties of composite dielectrics was studied by changing the direction of applied electric fields.

pmc-11562382.title: A very rare case of bone metaplasia of renal cyst: A case report
pmc-11562382.creator: Alemayehu Tegegne Tefera, Mensur Mohammed Ahmed, Desalew Gedamu Tareke, Ramzi Yessuf Adem
pmc-11562382.description: IntroductionRenal Osseous Metaplasia (OM) is a rare condition in which mature bone forms within the renal parenchyma, typically as focal cortical lesions. Although it is usually considered a spontaneous and less pathologically significant lesion, it has been observed in damaged renal allografts and other urinary tract sites.

pmc-12457809.creator: Mehmet Akif Ağır
pmc-12457809.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). y copper excretion in the diagnosis of pediatric Wilson disease (WD) are both timely and of potential clinical relevance. pmc-13181659.title: A retrospective cohort study on clinical features of foreign bodies in the gastrointestinal tract of children—emergency data from a pediatric regional medical center in eastern China
pmc-13181659.creator: Yufen Huang, Ying Zheng, Jiahuan Li, Lijia Wang
pmc-13181659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundGastrointestinal foreign bodies (GIFB) in children are one of the most common non-traumatic emergencies in pediatric emergency departments, showing an upward trend year by year in China. If processing is delayed, it can lead to catastrophic consequences. This study aims to clarify the epidemiological characteristics of GIFB in a certain area of eastern China and the independent risk factors for its complications, providing evidence-based thresholds and warning indicators for the regional emergency collaborative network.

pmc-13380658.title: The communication of science within the framework of European Union-funded research projects: Exploring practitioners’ experiences and perceptions
pmc-13380658.creator: Luis Arboledas-Lérida
pmc-13380658.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This article aims to advance our understanding of the communication of science conducted within the framework of externally funded research projects, also known as project-based science communication. It deploys semi-structured interviews to explore the experiences and perceptions of 26 communication specialists, project managers and other professionals who have been involved in the Communication & Dissemination Work Packages of Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe projects.

pmc-13591935.title: Staged TAVR and TEER for complex multivalvular disease in advanced heart failure: a case report
pmc-13591935.creator: Haoze Deng, Yiyang Li, Caiming Zhao, Bingyuan Zhou, You Zhou, Li Wang, Qinkao Xuan, Xiaodong Qian
pmc-13591935.description: BackgroundMultivalvular heart disease complicated by advanced heart failure in elderly patients represents a major therapeutic challenge, particularly in the presence of complex anatomy, severe ventricular remodeling, and high surgical risk. Staged transcatheter strategies may offer a less invasive and individualized therapeutic alternative.

pmc-13598011.title: Childhood trauma is associated with mobile phone dependency through self esteem and depressive symptoms in adolescents
pmc-13598011.creator: Qin Zhang, Xinbo Sun, Mingyue Gao, Li Wang, Chengqi Cao, Binbin Wang, Hejia Yan, Kunlin Zhang
pmc-13598011.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to examine the association between childhood trauma and mobile phone dependency among adolescents, as well as the mediating roles of self-esteem and depressive symptoms in this association. A questionnaire survey was conducted among 3,866 middle school students from Guizhou Province, using the Childhood Trauma Questionnaire-Short Form (CTQ-SF), the Self-Esteem Scale (SES), the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), and the Mobile Phone Addiction Index (MPAI).

pmc-13683847.title: Cutaneous endothelial cells and their roles in wound healing
pmc-13683847.creator: Haiming Li, Laura Sormani Le Bourhis, Seen-Ling Sim, Abbas Shafiee, Kiarash Khosrotehrani
pmc-13683847.description: Endothelial cells (ECs) form the inner monolayer of blood and lymphatic vessels play an essential role in skin homeostasis and wound healing. Upon injury, ECs rapidly engage in the healing response. ECs promote wound healing by forming new blood vessels through angiogenesis to supply oxygen, nutrients, and signals needed for tissue repair.
